anthropic.notes: USD per million tokens, from the 'Model pricing' table. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the page's separate 5-minute and 1-hour prompt-cache write rates (2x vs 1.25x base input, except Fable/Mythos 5.1's cache_read at 0.025x base input rather than the standard 0.1x). Keys are prefixes: account.py matches the longest configured prefix, so a dated/variant model id (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) still resolves against 'claude-haiku-4-5'. Only global inference_geo, standard speed, and non-batch service_tier are priced here -- see account.py's guard rails for the rest.

typesafe.notes: TypeSafe has no dedicated pricing page as of the retrieval date. The homepage states input cost as '$42 per billion input tokens' ($0.042/MTok), and https://docs.typesafe.ai/models confirms 'Output tokens are free.' Neither page publishes cache pricing (Jev is a stateless per-call decision API; no documented prompt caching), so cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h/cache_read are left null rather than guessed.
